{{Vanilla|Copper Ore}}
{{Infobox auto}}
'''Native Copper''' is the renamed copper ore.

The deepslate variant is '''native deepslate copper'''.

== Obtaining ==
=== Natural generation ===
As vanilla copper ore.

=== Breaking ===
Mined with a pickaxe (see [[Tools#Mining levels]]), it drops 1–2 raw copper (2–5 from the deepslate variant); adamant tools drop copper ingots. Silk Touch drops the block.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/blocks/copper_ore.json}}</ref>
